name: The Undercroft
description: A hidden warren of cutouts, handlers, and dead drops beneath the campus — the spine of the guild's espionage. Each tier lets the guild run more informants and more Veiled Concord contracts at once, and the deepest tier opens the cabal's lethal work.

tiers.description: A first quiet room and a handful of trusted couriers. Up to 2 informants may run at once and 1 Veiled Concord contract may be in play.

A standing corps of handlers works the networks so companions need not. Up to 4 informants and 2 contracts at once, and the Undercroft itself runs your assets — unhandled informants take less heat from counter-intelligence.

Tradecraft deep enough to reach the Inner cabal. Up to 6 informants and 3 contracts at once; the guild may commission Assassination from the Veiled Concord, and every contract leaves a shorter shadow (−1 Marked per completed contract).
